subject: Private hotpatch governance check-in and rollback runbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Daugherty <mike.daugherty@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Private hotpatch governance check-in and rollback runbook

Folks,

We need to firm up the governance and rollback controls for the private VPC hotpatch we discussed with AcmeHealth. They want a narrow maintenance window next week for a critical CVE fix, but they also requested explicit rollback criteria and a short-circuit escalation path if the patch causes regressions.

Top asks for this thread:
- Review the attached runbook and network preflight checklist (hotpatch-runbook-v2.pdf, network-preflight-checklist.csv).
- Confirm canary gating: success thresholds for P50/P95 latency, error rate delta, and KV cache hit ratio.
- Define manual abort conditions and automated fallback behavior (model pin fallback, route to Dedicated pool).
- Identify who will own on-call for each shard during the window.

Proposed maintenance window: 2028-08-04 01:00–03:00 UTC (US night). Can we confirm?

Karthik
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hotpatch-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook), network-preflight-checklist.csv (CSV)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Daugherty <mike.daugherty@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private hotpatch governance check-in and rollback runbook

Thanks Karthik — I read the runbook and sketched a quick gating matrix. Two clarifying items:

1) Canary scope: are we canarying 5% of traffic per AZ or 10% per node? That affects our KV warmup and prefix caching expectations. I recommend 5% per AZ for the first 30 minutes, then evaluate.
2) Automated fallback: the runbook mentions falling back to a "compatible model variant." We need a clear mapping table of model_version -> fallback_version and the binary compatibility constraints. Can Dev produce that?

I'll add a short network drain step to the preflight checklist: slow-concurrent-drain of non-essential worker lanes for 15 minutes prior to applying patches. Also flagging the need for a pre-window snapshot of routing tables and iptables on the customer edge (EdgeCloud Ops) — Mike, can your ops team produce those artifacts?

Soojin
Principal SRE, Private Deployments

Date: 2028-08-02T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private hotpatch governance check-in and rollback runbook

Adding schedule and explicit owners. Per discussion, the maintenance window is confirmed for 2028-08-04 01:00–03:00 UTC. Owners:
- Patch execution (apply + smoke): Dev Patel (on-call: dev_patch_team)
- Canary monitoring & thresholds: Soojin Lee (on-call: infra_alerts)

Rollback/abort criteria (short):
- If P95 latency increases by >30% vs baseline for >=10 minutes -> abort and rollout rollback image.
- If error rate (5xx) increases >2% absolute vs baseline for >=5 minutes -> abort.
- If KV cache hit ratio falls by >12% -> abort and divert canary traffic to Dedicated pool.

Planned canary sequence:
1) Stage patch on canary hosts (5% traffic/AZ) and wait 20 minutes.
2) Evaluate metrics and logs (dashboard link in attached canary-metrics-dashboard-link.txt).
3) If green, ramp to 25% for 30 minutes.
4) If still green, proceed to full patch.

Network preflight notes (from checklist): ensure BGP sessions stable, confirm symmetric routing for egress paths, capture iptables and custom NAT maps. EdgeCloud Ops to provide iptables snapshot and peering logs 24h before window.

Attachments included for execs: hotpatch-runbook-v2.pdf (final edits), network-preflight-checklist.csv. I uploaded a small helper CSV with per-host rollback images mapping. Dev — please confirm the compatibility table by EOD 2028-08-02.

Marissa
Manager, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Daugherty <mike.daugherty@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-05T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private hotpatch governance check-in and rollback runbook

Quick updates:
- Compatibility table attached inline (see CSV column references in network-preflight-checklist.csv). All canary hosts have validated fallback images and the migration script supports immediate rollback via image swap + kv cache flush. Estimated rollback time ~7–9 minutes in the worst case.
- I added an automated abort hook tied to the canary alert that will automatically scale down the patched pool to 0 and switch routing to the pinned version if thresholds are breached.
- EdgeCloud Ops confirmed they'll capture iptables and BGP snapshots; Mike provided a signed logistics acknowledgement this morning.

I also ran a dry-run against a staging VPC and captured a failure-mode where the cache warmup was slower than expected; note we should lengthen the first canary hold to 30 minutes if the customer traffic has heavy KV use.

Next steps:
- Soojin to finalize gating thresholds (I left placeholders in the runbook).
- Marissa to post the final runbook and the non-interactive rollback script to the private bucket by 2028-08-03 12:00 UTC.
- Karthik to send a customer-facing maintenance note for AcmeHealth by EOD.

Thanks — I’ll be on-call during the window.

Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Private Runtime
